hero.name: Boris Sargsyan
hero.tagline: Studying how systems break, so I can help build the ones that don't.
hero.intro: Cybersecurity student at Marist University, originally from Yerevan, Armenia, and a recent IB Diploma graduate of UWC Dilijan. Before university I built and shipped real things as like a custom software platform for a student-run, charity based business, a fleet of FPV drones designed and flown from scratch, and 15+ completed programming courses across Python, Java, C/C++, JavaScript, and SQL.

about.heading: About
paragraphs:
I'm an cybersecurity student at Marist University. My path here started at UWC Dilijan, where I completed the IB Diploma while building things on the side as like a full operations platform for a student-run business, a self-built fleet of FPV drones, and a stack of self-directed courses in Python, Java, C/C++, JavaScript, and SQL.

Outside the classroom, I compete as an Armenian national Taekwondo champion and hold a 1st Dan black belt, the same discipline that now drives how I approach learning security from the ground up. I'm currently working through foundational ethical hacking and network security material and looking for an internship where I can put it to use on a real team.

projects.title: Bolik — Student-Run Charitable Business
projects.description: Co-founded and built the operations platform for Bolik, a student-run bubble tea shop at UWC Dilijan used by 47.66% of students throughout the 2025–2026 school year and still in use by current students and leaders.
tech: Full-stack development · Product ownership · Team leadership

timeline.title: B.S. Cybersecurity
timeline.description: Coursework in network security, applied cryptography, and systems administration. Active member of the Cybersecurity Club.

timeline.title: IT Security Intern
timeline.description: Assisted with quarterly vulnerability scans, monitored SIEM alerts, and helped triage phishing reports across small-business client environments.

timeline.title: Cybersecurity Club — Member
timeline.description: Participate in weekly CTF practice and help organize introductory security workshops for new students.

timeline.title: IB Diploma
timeline.description: Completed the International Baccalaureate Diploma. Led an independent project auditing and hardening the school's network, which sparked an interest in cybersecurity.
